remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated first-floor end unit, offering every modern convenience you could want. Recently refreshed from top to bottom, this turn-key rental features refinished floors, new paint, new light fixtures, and a fully updated bathroom. The new stove, refrigerator and dryer make the kitchen and laundry space feel brand new. Enjoy the comfort of central air, in-unit laundry, and two dedicated parking spots. The layout is efficient and inviting, with a bright living area and generously sized bedrooms. A unique bonus is the dry crawl space, accessible through a hatch, providing valuable additional storage. Step outside to your private back patio through the back sliding doors, overlooking a quiet church property; a peaceful setting perfect for unwinding after a long day. Location is truly unbeatable: walk to downtown SoNo, the movie theater, great restaurants, the SoNo Collection Mall, and the South Norwalk Train Station. Commuters will also love the quick access to I-95. Also note that the association is having the entire exterior fence in the complex replaced. This unit has everything you need and more-style, convenience, updates, and an incredible location. Don't miss this exceptional rental!
